newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Nineteen bus passengers drown in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Nineteen bus passengers drown in Morocco.

text.p: Nineteen people drowned on Friday when the bus they were travelling in plunged into a river in central Morocco, the Moroccan news agency MAP said on Saturday.
The crash occured near Ouled Ben Tahar village, 255 km (170 miles) northeast of Rabat, MAP said.
Seven people were rescued and up to 14 others were missing, the agency added.
